title: BasePrimitive
description:
The universal base contract shared by every Operational DNA primitive. All per-primitive schemas extend this via allOf.

Fields:
- id: UUID v4 — stable identity for this definition across data stores.
- type: lowercase primitive discriminator (e.g. 'resource', 'operation'). Constrained to a single const value by each per-primitive schema.
- name: the human-readable definition name used for cross-references and authoring.
- version: the version of this primitive type's schema that was in effect when the primitive was authored. Increment is a migration signal — see operational/versions.json for the current version per type.
- description: optional human-readable explanation.

id.description: UUID v4 identifier for this primitive definition. Stable across updates. Auto-assigned by builders when not supplied.

type.description: Lowercase primitive discriminator. Constrained to a single const value by each per-primitive schema.

name.description: The human-readable name of this definition, used for cross-references throughout the DNA document.

version.description: The version of this primitive type's schema in effect when the primitive was authored. A migration handle — see operational/versions.json for the current version per type. Any increment MUST be accompanied by at least a semantic minor bump to @dna-codes/dna-schemas.

stability.description: Optional declared concept maturity (Kubernetes API-maturity model). Orthogonal to `version`. When present, it flows into registry seeding as the seeded type's stability; when absent, the registry's seeding defaults apply (foundational types `stable`, everything else `experimental`).

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this primitive represents.
